description: The National Research Council Canada provides climate time series for building simulations at 564 Canadian reference locations. The files use bias-corrected Canadian Regional Climate Model version 4 large-ensemble simulations. They cover a 1991–2021 historical baseline and future periods corresponding to warming increments from 0.5 to 3.5 degrees Celsius; the registry gives an overall span of 1991–2094. Variables include temperature, rainfall, solar radiation and atmospheric pressure. The NRC landing page provides access to archived files, with the registry listing approximately 368 GB in total. Reuse is free under the Open Government Licence, Canada. These are climate-model projections, so bias correction does not remove future scenario uncertainty. They provide weather inputs for building performance and overheating simulations alongside model-energyplus. File-level compatibility and the underlying data have not been tested.
